items.text: Init stops on load failure — a failed bootstrap fetch shows a reload toast and an in-dashboard error panel with Reload; window.dashboardInstance is set so retry works.
HTTP checks on startup — /api/pages, /api/settings, /api/finders, and bookmark fetches verify response.ok before parsing JSON.
Inline-edit guard — renderDashboard() and loadPageBookmarks() skip or confirm while unsaved inline edits are open; Quick Add and :new no longer desync the editor.
Config sync retry that works — bookmark reloads use { rethrow: true } inside withRetry; failed structure/settings refresh shows a retry toast instead of rendering stale data.
Pending config sync — reconcilePendingConfigSyncAfterLoad() refreshes when a save landed after navigation; pending keys stay until sync succeeds.

Config sync without reload — cross-tab sync shows retry toasts instead of window.location.reload(); the storage listener ignores unrelated keys and uses an in-flight guard against overlapping refreshes.
Page rename & bookmark move — page-tab rename and cross-page moves verify POST response.ok and roll back on failure.
Corrupt device settings — bad dashboardSettings JSON in localStorage falls back to server settings instead of breaking init.
BFCache restore — back/forward cache navigation no longer tears down keyboard, swipe, and tag-cloud listeners; pageshow with persisted re-inits interaction modules.
Page tab sync — loadPageBookmarks() updates the active tab (aria-selected / .active) after every successful navigation — hash, page overview, swipe, and deep links included.
Navigation success signal — loadPageBookmarks() returns true/false; requestPageNavigation() no longer reports success when the load failed.
Single inline-edit confirm — page navigation confirms once via skipInlineEditConfirm instead of showing two discard dialogs.
Consistent page IDs — samePageId() normalizes comparisons across tabs, hash, page overview, deep links, and swipe wrap.
Extension save stays on page — nextdash:bookmark-saved for another page refreshes allBookmarks only; it no longer navigates you away.
Page overview counts — , overview lazy-loads allBookmarks when per-page counts are not yet available.
Smarter all-bookmarks load — needsCrossPageBookmarks() checks per-feature page filters; Today-only default installs defer /api/bookmarks?all=true until after first paint, then re-render.
Tag cloud & overview data — showTagCloudButton is included in cross-page bookmark needs; tag cloud and page overview get correct counts.
Empty smart collections — Recent, Stale, and Most Used collections are omitted when they have zero bookmarks.
Shared visual settings — dashboard loads visual-settings.js; background presets and opacity/animation helpers are no longer duplicated in dashboard.js.
Deferred non-critical scripts — tours, onboarding, analytics, what's-new stub, and PWA hint use defer for faster first paint.
Single locale fetch — removed the duplicate loadTranslations block from dashboard.html; language.init() handles i18n.
Weather line safety — location/condition text uses textContent instead of innerHTML.
Tag cloud lifecycle — close-animation timer is cancellable; destroy() removes all listeners; swipe re-init calls cleanup() first.
Code cleanup — removed dead mouse-swipe handlers; merged duplicate visibilitychange listeners; tag-filter indicator skips unchanged DOM rebuilds.
Safe bookmark links — main grid and recent-modal links use safeHttpResourceUrl; javascript: and data: URLs cannot navigate.
Empty-state escaping — page names, labels, hints, and category-empty copy use escapeHtml or textContent instead of raw innerHTML.
Tip sanitization — rotating header tips allow only <code> and safe internal <a class="button-hint-link"> links.
:new modal escaping — page/category <option> labels and icon preview filenames are escaped or built with safe DOM APIs.
Tag-filter Escape focus — clearing an active tag filter with Esc restores keyboard focus to bookmarks (same as tag cloud Clear).
Localized tag counts — tag cloud chip tooltips/aria use tagFilterCountOne / tagFilterCountMany via the dashboard formatter.
Cheat sheet & tips gating — the / tag-cloud shortcut appears in the keyboard cheatsheet and rotating tips only on desktop when the tag cloud is enabled and tags exist.
Auto-dark listener guard — the dashboard fallback for autoDarkMode attaches one matchMedia listener instead of stacking on every settings apply.
